title: The Five Drawers-Upward and the Architecture of Resurrection
description: The Five Sons of the Awakener as the discrete ascending operations by which the spiritually dead are raised through the degrees back to the Father. Five operations of the Lord answering to the five faculties of the soul — every degree at which a soul has been bound must have its own corresponding lift. The fifth gathers all lives inward and they rest in their image. The names by which the cosmos calls these awakeners — Stillness, Fast, Day, Rest, Peace — are the qualities of the sabbath-state.
